 Live India vs New Zealand Live score, 5th ODI: Santner strikes twice in the same over, India slump to eight down
 By Aratrick Mondal Nov 15, 2026, 10:39:12 IST India vs New Zealand Live score, 5th ODI: Catch live updates of the series finale in Mount Maunganui
 Key Events 18 Sec ago Last wicket falls 
 1 Mins ago India go past 200 
 3 Mins ago Ishan misses his 50 too 
 15 Mins ago Two SIXES in one over 
 25 Mins ago Satner strikes again 
 27 Mins ago 7th wicket fall 
 35 Mins ago Santner gets Dhir 
 41 Mins ago Shastri praises Dhir 
 55 Mins ago India cautious 
 1 Hr 9 Mins ago Axar in disbelief 
 1 Hr 21 Mins ago 100 up for India 
 1 Hr 24 Mins ago Ishan survives 
 1 Hr 39 Mins ago Iyer OUT! 
 1 Hr 42 Mins ago Power cut in Bay Oval 
 1 Hr 54 Mins ago Time to rebuild for India 
 1 Hr 57 Mins ago Gaiwad's wasted opportunity 
 8:26 AM IST, Nov 15 Dropped! 
 8:21 AM IST, Nov 15 3rd wicket falls 
 8:12 AM IST, Nov 15 Not the fondest farewell for Ro-Ko! 
 8:06 AM IST, Nov 15 Kohli OUT! 
 8:03 AM IST, Nov 15 What a shot! 
 7:56 AM IST, Nov 15 Rohit falls! 
 7:50 AM IST, Nov 15 Fluent start from Gaikwad 
 7:38 AM IST, Nov 15 And so it begins! 
 7:21 AM IST, Nov 15 Matt Henry threat 
 7:15 AM IST, Nov 15 A look at the playing XIs 
 7:12 AM IST, Nov 15 Siraj returns 
 7:08 AM IST, Nov 15 New Zealand have 4 seamers again 
 7:04 AM IST, Nov 15 Toss time! 
 7:01 AM IST, Nov 15 India will have a debutant today 
 6:54 AM IST, Nov 15 Welcome! 
 India's Ishan Kishan plays a shot against New Zealand during a One Day International cricket match in New Zealand India vs New Zealand Live score, 5th ODI: For one last time, the two teams face off in a white-ball game in this series . India won the opening two matches, and looked to seal the series in the third, which was washed out due to rain. The home team then came back storming in the fourth match to pull one back in their name. Expect a thrilling finale at Mount Maunganui today. ...Read More 
 Follow all the updates here: Nov 15, 2026, 10:39:12 IST Last wicket falls
 New Zealand manage to fold India for 209 in 42.1 overs. Duffy takes the final wicket, dismissing Arshdeep. 
 Nov 15, 2026, 10:38:14 IST India go past 200
 A six from Siraj gets India past the 200-run mark. Just wildly swings his bat at the fuller delivery from Satner. The fielder in the deep makes the run, grabs the ball, but falls over the boundary rope. He did make an effort to throw the ball back into play before falling over, but the feet had touched the boundary cushion already. Siraj ends the over with a four.
 India 209/9 in 42 overs
 Nov 15, 2026, 10:36:01 IST Ishan misses his 50 too
 Like Axar, Ishan too falls for 46. Duffy, who was hit for two sixes in his previous over by the batter, gets his revenge. However, Arshdeep Singh comes out all guns blazing, smashing a four and two sixes in the remaining four balls of the over.
 India 197/9 in 41 overs
 Nov 15, 2026, 10:24:26 IST Two SIXES in one over
 Ishan has had enough of staying at the other end and watching the team crumble. He has taken matters into his own hand as he smashes Duffy for two sixes in the 39th over, both over backward square, to move to 46.
 India 180/8 in 39 overs
 Nov 15, 2026, 10:14:00 IST Satner strikes again
 Double wicket maiden for the captain, as he gets debutant Yash Thakur for a duck on the last ball. Ishan can do nothing but stare at the two wickets falling in tandem from the other end.
 India 166/8 in 36 overs
 Nov 15, 2026, 10:11:36 IST 7th wicket fall
 Oh...New Zealand bowlers are all over India. Auqib Nabi falls for just 5 off 9 as Satner picks up his second wicket. That was a simple catch for Finn Allen at cover. India go 7 down for just 166 runs.
 Nov 15, 2026, 10:03:53 IST Santner gets Dhir
 That was a very, very slow delivery. Dhir falls for it. He hits the fuller one looking to clear the deep cover boundary, but finda the fielder in the deep. Full marks to Santner. Dhir goes back for 22. 
 Everytime India are looking to stitch a partnership, New Zealand are finding a way to get a wicket. 
 India 160/6 in 33.2 overs
 Nov 15, 2026, 09:57:43 IST Shastri praises Dhir
 Dhir is getting into the rhythm with a four against Santner right after the break. Shastri reckons he has the ability to become a mainstay in the format, and calls him a find for India on the tour. He's handy with the ball as well.
 India 155/5 in 32 overs
 Nov 15, 2026, 09:43:49 IST India cautious
 More caution from India at the moment. They have lost half their side already, another wicket will expose the tail-end. Ishan will be the key for India at the moment, and he gets a four against Bracewell to move into his 20s, and will expect Naman to join in quickly, before one of them decide to take the aggressive route.
 India 138/5 in 29 overs
 Nov 15, 2026, 09:30:02 IST Axar in disbelief
 Oh…he misses out on his 50! Axar can't believe it. He is looking down at the pitch. The ball stuck on the wicket a bit, slowed down and the lofted shot carried straight to fielder at midwicket. Bracewell gets him for 46. 
 India 121/5 in 25 overs
 Nov 15, 2026, 09:18:15 IST 100 up for India
 A four of Axar against Tickner, crunched through the cover, and India breach the 100-run mark. This has been quite a struggle for the visitors, but Axar is holding the key. He has faced the most balls so far for India. he gets another boundary, in the fourth ball. Short ball and he goes on his back foot to punch it wide of backward point for a boundary.
 India 107/4 in 22 overs
 Nov 15, 2026, 09:14:47 IST Ishan survives
 Short ball from Tickner and it nips back to off as Ishan goes for the pull shot, mistimes it and the keeper takes it behind. New Zealand appeal for a caught behind, but the ball did not take the edge, and rather flicked his thigh. Ishan responds with a four on the fifth ball.
 India 97/4 in 21 overs
 Nov 15, 2026, 09:00:11 IST Iyer OUT!
 Broadcast resumes, but perhaps with the spare camera. It is only showing from the deep cover boundary. That's how we have to manage. And as things resumed, Iyer fell. 
 Short ball does the trick and Tickner gets rid of him. Caught at mid-on, he goes back for 22 off 26.
 Nov 15, 2026, 08:57:19 IST Power cut in Bay Oval
 Axar scores a four against Kristian Clarke ion the final ball pf the 14th over and then a six against Blair Tickner. And if you are wondering what is wrong with the broadcast, there's a power cut at the venue
 Nov 15, 2026, 08:44:36 IST Time to rebuild for India
 Axar and Iyer have both been dropped once thus far, but are looking promising in rebuilding the innings for India in Bay Oval. They have stitched a 34-run stand off 35 balls, taking India to 68/3 in 14 overs. But New Zealand are still holding the edge. The pitch is holding at times and there's bounce when it is dug in.
 Nov 15, 2026, 08:42:04 IST Gaiwad's wasted opportunity
 With Gill not there in the final two matches of the series, it was a nice chance for Gaikwad to stake his claim as a back-up opener, but he managed just 23 runs in two innings in New Zealand. Overall, he has played just five ODIs since the end of September, and his only standout show was in New Chandigarh, where he scored 57 against the West Indies.
 Nov 15, 2026, 08:26:37 IST Dropped!
 Duffy dishes out a length ball, outside off. Iyer, with lazy hands, chases at it, gets an outside edge. But Finn Allen drops it at third slip. Iyer survives. And then Axar survives a run out on the very next ball. New Zealand are creating chances. 
 India 47/3 in 11 overs
 Nov 15, 2026, 08:21:23 IST 3rd wicket falls
 It's Gaikwad this time. India in trouble! Duffy strikes. Fuller ball, nips back and Gaikwad goes for the forward drive, but gets a thick inside edge and Seifert takes a nice catch.
 India 37/3 in 9 overs
 Nov 15, 2026, 08:12:24 IST Not the fondest farewell for Ro-Ko!
 If this, by all indication, is indeed their last and final appearance on New Zealand soil in professional cricket, Kohli and Rohit endured a forgettable campaign. Rohit managed just 30 runs in four innings, which included two dismissals for duck. Kohli, on the other hand, did start off the series with a stunning 74 in Auckland, but scored just 12 more runs in the next three innings, which also included a dismissal for duck.
 Nov 15, 2026, 08:06:19 IST Kohli OUT!
 It's Fisher again! He gets another huge wicket, and this time Kohli goes. Shorter delivery, outside off and Kohli throws the kitchen sink at it. The top-edge flies and Tim Seifert makes no mistake. He goes to his right, leaps and takes the catch. Kohli goes back for 5 off 7.
 India 33/2 in 7.3 overs
 Nov 15, 2026, 08:03:08 IST What a shot!
 Another boundary and it's Gaikwad again. What a shot! Picks up the shorter length and pulls it disdainfully over mid-wicket...one bounce and over the ropes.
 India 33/1 in 7 overs
 Nov 15, 2026, 07:56:40 IST Rohit falls!
 Fisher strikes and gets the big wicket of Rohit Sharma. New Zealand continued with the fuller length. But this was a tad slower. Rohit flicks it straight to Dean Foxcroft at mid-wicket. He goes back for just 7 off 13. 
 India 23/1 in 5.3 overs
 Nov 15, 2026, 07:50:26 IST Fluent start from Gaikwad
 Two boundaries against Fisher in the second over. The first one was an outside edge, which would have been an easy catch in the slip cordon, but it went for a four. The othet was clipped away towards the vacant mid-wicket area. He has been looking more confident today.
 India 21/0 in 4 overs
 Nov 15, 2026, 07:38:23 IST And so it begins!
 Rohit Sharma and Ruturaj Gaikwad are at the crease. Jacob Duffy takes the new ball.
 Oh...what a start. Beaten! First ball, outswinger and Rohit survives a scare. But the batter responds with a four on the fourth ball, lofted over cover.
 India 5/0 in 1 over
 Nov 15, 2026, 07:26:06 IST Time for national anthem
 India go first, followed by the home team, New Zealand.
